steps.name: Community Guard
steps.text: Tecno, Papá, there are soldiers putting up barbed wire downstairs.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Soldiers? What are they doing here?

steps.name: Community Guard
steps.text: They showed us warrants. They say they're here to investigate fire hazards.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Uh... Is that something the military handles? Isn't this a job for those dumb civil servants?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Tecno, take the elderly and children away from here. Go to the Rhodes Island office and get Ernesto.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Everyone else, come with me, and bring weapons. Don't count on getting a good night's sleep.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I-I'm staying!

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: You have the best Arts of us all. You're the only one I can trust to get them out of here.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Tecno, I'm giving you an important mission. Protect them, at all costs.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Okay... Papá.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: May I ask your purpose here?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Diaz González, I remember you. You came to Dossoles and became a firefighter after you left the Singas army.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: You fought fires for five years, putting yourself in danger countless times, and earning just as many commendations.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: How did you fall so far as to end up in this stinking place?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: I'm a firefighter. It doesn't matter where I am. I'm always fighting fires. A fire in a luxury hotel is still a fire, and so is a fire in a back alley.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: If there's a fire, I can and will fight it.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Hah... The way I see it, you're one of us, Diaz. I'm sure you'll cooperate, right?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Enough. I know what it is you're scheming. You call this a fire safety inspection, but you're just trying to chase us away.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: This is all in the interest of safety. You don't want a repeat of that disaster a couple years ago, do you?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Get out of here. I have things under control. You don't get to tell us what to do.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Oh, that simply won't do, Diaz. This puppet show has drawn the eyes of the entire city. What happens here is about more than just you now.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: We'll make sure that your show doesn't have an adverse effect on the public at large.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: I told you to get lost!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Oh, you don't get it, do you? We're here to conduct an inspection. We came prepared.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Alright boys, make sure you check every last one of them. Don't let any potential danger slip through your fingers.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Anyone who gets in the way of our inspection is endangering public safety. Show them no mercy.

steps.name: Officer's Subordinate
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Coño... These thugs.

steps.name: Small Child
steps.text: Tecno, I'm scared... Where are we going?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Some bad guys forced their way into our neighborhood. It's not safe here. I'm taking you to Ernesto.

steps.name: Elderly Woman
steps.text: What about the others...? Are we just going to leave them here?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Papá told me to look after you... He said... he'd stay and take care of the rest.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: They're coming this way. We need to hurry.

steps.name: Community Electrician
steps.text: What's this about?!

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Inspect all of the puppets' power lines. If you find anything risky, tear them all out.

steps.name: Community Electrician
steps.text: Hey, it took me forever to put all this together. Leave those alone!

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Out of the way, public nuisance.

steps.name: Community Electrician
steps.text: Come on, man. Don't do this. Be reasonable. You're looking at half a year's worth of blood, sweat, and tears... Don't ruin it. Please, don't...

steps.name: Irate Soldier
steps.text: Like I give a shit how many months you put into this. I should lock you up right now for this flagrant violation of electrical safety.

steps.name: Community Electrician
steps.text: Stop—!

steps.name: Community Electrician
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Officer's Subordinate
steps.text: Conchetumare, enough with the wailing.

steps.name: Community Electrician
steps.text: *whimper*... Don't!

steps.name: Harsh Officer
steps.text: What the hell is this place? Some kind of hideout? Didn't expect it to be this clean.

steps.name: Officer's Subordinate
steps.text: Sir, the puppets are right outside the window. Open them up and you'll see.

steps.name: Harsh Officer
steps.text: Take a look, see how much foam and wood they stuffed in them? What if they were to catch fire?

steps.name: Harsh Officer
steps.text: Tear them apart!

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: Thugs, all of you! You should rot in hell!

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Ugh... What a bunch of beasts... So thoughtless...

steps.name: Operating Crew Director
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: Boss!

steps.name: Harsh Officer
steps.text: What are you people doing?! Didn't I tell you to round them up and bring them to the field? Get the lead out!

steps.name: Officer's Subordinate
steps.text: His people are putting up a struggle. It's been difficult to get them under control.

steps.name: Harsh Officer
steps.text: Then follow my lead and start cracking skulls, you idiot!

steps.name: Harsh Officer
steps.text: See? Look how calm he is now.

steps.name: Operating Crew
steps.text: Bastards... You bastards...

steps.name: Harsh Officer
steps.text: Now get them out of here. Those puppets are huge, it's gonna be plenty of work taking them apart.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: We're almost out. They probably wouldn't expect us to come this way...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Abuela, watch your step, the ground is slippery. Let me help you.

steps.name: Elderly Woman
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Small Child
steps.text: Tecno, will we ever come back?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Of course. This is our home.

steps.name: Small Child
steps.text: But those men tore everything down... If we come back, we'll have to spend so much time to get everything back to how it was.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: They'll pay for that. I swear...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: When we get back, I'll help you put everything right. I promise...

steps.name: Elderly Woman
steps.text: Quickly now. It's still a long walk to the office.

steps.name: Small Child
steps.text: Abuelita, I'll help you.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Stay close, everyone.

steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Tecno? Ellie? Come in, hurry! What are you guys doing here?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Where's Ernesto? I need his help.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: He said he had something personal to take care of and went off on his own. He's still not back.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ela and I are the only ones here now. What's going on?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Coalition forces have surrounded the neighborhood. They're tearing down our puppet show under the guise of a fire inspection... Papá told me to bring everyone here to lay low.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Tecno... What's the situation over there now?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I... I don't know. On the way here, all I could hear was the sounds of them breaking everything... A lot of people were crying, and I don't know if they were hurt or not...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Those thugs...!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I... I need to go back. I'm worried about Papá. He was acting brave, telling me to leave and let him deal with the soldiers...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: But... he's not nearly as strong as he used to be... He's old now, even if his tongue is as sharp as ever.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I have to go, Ela.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Don't cry, Tecno. We'll go with you.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: We will help you.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Doc here will stay and take care of the elderly and the children. Don't worry about them.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Ela, Tecno's people here are all fine. They don't need me.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: It's the ones in that neighborhood who need my help. I'll go with you.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: These vents are way too long.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I'm covered in dust. *cough*.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: How is it, Doc? Can you get down?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I have pretty broad hips... I think I'm stuck.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Give me your hand. I'll pull you out.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Oof—!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: The vents may be great for you guys to crawl around, but I have a hard time just squeezing myself into them.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: They have the place completely surrounded, and they're covering the way we came out, too. The vents are our only path.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Fuze, give me a sitrep.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: It's more complicated than we thought. They have a large number of troops standing guard outside the neighborhood. I had to break off, but the explosives are in place.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Ready to detonate.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: How is it looking outside the window?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: There are way more men than I anticipated... They took everyone outside.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Is anyone hurt?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Then, is anyone...?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No. Don't worry. They're alive.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Phew... That's good to hear.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Ela, there are snipers on the roof. We need to take care of them first.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Doc, you and Tecno stay here. Wait for our signal before you act.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: What are you looking for, Tecno?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: The storage device. All our design documents are stored on it. They destroyed our puppets, but as long as we still have that, we can rebuild them someday.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I'll help you look for it.

steps.name: Slacking Officer
steps.text: Well, I thought I was just up here for a smoke. I didn't expect to run into a few sneaky musbeasts.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I'll deal with him. Go get the storage device. It's in the top shelf of that cabinet.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Slacking Officer
steps.text: Señorita, maybe you should let your friend take me on instead. A little girl like you can't land a finger on me!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Oh yeah?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: *sigh*... You shouldn't have taunted her...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Didn't your mother ever teach you not to look down on people?! Time to teach you a lesson!

steps.name: Slacking Officer
steps.text: Agh! My leg!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Little girl? I'm a little girl because I'm short?

steps.name: Slacking Officer
steps.text: My nose!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Little girl? Vete a la chingada!

steps.name: Slacking Officer
steps.text: Ugh—

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Dealt with him. Did you find the storage device?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Bad news. There's nothing on the top of the cabinet. Someone took the device.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Who... Who could've taken it?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: You can stop glaring at me, Señor Diaz. I asked you to cooperate with us. You only have yourselves to blame for all these wounded.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Pfft. You can drop the act. Who are you trying to fool?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Hold him down!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Oof... fearsome fellow. If I didn't have my men here, you might've actually cut me down.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: I'm afraid I have some bad news. Our inspection turned up a lot of serious hazards. Especially those puppets.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Once activated, they could have a serious adverse effect on the whole neighborhood's energy supply, maybe even the surrounding neighborhoods.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: That's why I gathered all of you here, to give you a warning.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Who... sent you?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: There are plenty who think fondly of this place... and just as many who want to get rid of us...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: But all they ever do is come at us... They don't spare a thought to what we do.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Once you're there, your top priority is to destroy those puppets. And do it in full view of everyone.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Cut off water and electricity, drive them out of the place... That comes later. For now, we provoke them, anger them, and then...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Draw the fires of their fury where they must burn.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I'll be waiting there for good news.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Except him...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Except that man...

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Do you really have to ask, if you've already figured it out?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Is this all of them?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Do it.

The moment the officer gives the order, the soldiers standing by swarm in. The puppets' bodies are rapidly torn apart, their materials and internal wiring scattered all across the ground, until only their heads lean against each other.
Their once swift pupils fall from their eye sockets, exposing the torn wiring inside.
There is a deafening silence among the assembled crowd. Many choose to look away, unable to bear witness to this atrocity.
Only Diaz looks on without so much as a blink. His eyes are filled with fury.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Oh, right, I found this... storage device on one of your shelves. I had a man check it for me. Your design documents are all in here, along with a bunch of other things.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: You've destroyed enough already. Won't you spare us this?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: We have to eradicate all threats, Señor Diaz.
An almost inaudible weeping can be heard in the silent crowd. Even a man as headstrong as Diaz is unable to keep his eyes stony.
Give that to me, you thug!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Out of the way!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Coño. She snatched it.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: What are you idiots doing? Who let this punk in here? Seize her!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Stop resisting, and hand that over!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Let go of me!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Trying to use Arts?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Hand it over!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Pft, in your dreams.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: You dare kick me?!
The officer, after getting a kick in the face from Tecno, angrily shoves her to the ground and attempts to snatch the device back, but the Durin keeps a tight grip on it throughout the whole ordeal.
After multiple fruitless attempts, the officer gives up. He stands up, expressionless, and stomps violently onto Tecno's tightly clenched fist.
Again and again, until his sole is dyed solid crimson.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Still won't let go, huh?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I... I won't... Take it from me... If you can...
The moment he lifts his knee again, a red beam shines from the roof of a building up above, with a small red dot landing on his forehead.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Try stomping her again.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: If you want to know what it feels like to have three bullets enter your body at the same time, go ahead.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: What... took you so long?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I'd die if I leapt from the fourth floor of a building.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Hrmph.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Take your men with you, sir, all of them. Or you'll have more than bullets waving hello.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Fine, we completed our objectives... No reason to waste any more time with you.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Notify all units. We're pulling out.
